title: Seeing Is Not Acting: WARD Diagnoses the Evidence-to-State-to-Action Gap in Longitudinal Clinical Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.29243v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models for longitudinal clinical care must revise their assessments and actions as patient information accumulates. However, benchmarks centered on isolated responses or final task outcomes provide limited insight into intermediate failures in evidence use, state updating, and action selection. We introduce WARD, a benchmark for evaluating how clinical agents translate accumulating evidence into patient-state judgments and timely, safe actions. WARD comprises 4,560 clinical tasks across seven clinical output domains, organized into 240 checkpoints from 40 longitudinal clinical trajectories spanning 95 hospitalizations. Its Longitudinal Track evaluates these tasks under controlled cumulative evidence. Its Interactive Track evaluates end-to-end, tool-mediated clinical management across 271 verifiable evidence items and 141 reference transitions. translated_title: 看见不等于行动：WARD 诊断纵向临床智能体中“证据-状态-行动”的差距
translated_abstract: 用于纵向临床护理的大语言模型必须随着患者信息的积累而不断修正其评估和行动。然而，以孤立响应或最终任务结果为中心的基准测试，对证据使用、状态更新和行动选择等中间环节的失败所提供的洞察十分有限。我们提出了 WARD，一个用于评估临床智能体如何将不断积累的证据转化为患者状态判断以及及时、安全行动的基准。WARD 包含覆盖七个临床输出领域的 4,560 个临床任务，这些任务被组织成来自 40 条纵向临床轨迹（跨越 95 次住院）的 240 个检查点。其纵向赛道在受控的累积证据条件下评估这些任务；其交互式赛道则评估端到端的、由工具介导的临床管理，涵盖 271 个可验证的证据项目和 141 个参考状态转变。在 12 个具有可评分检查点输出的模型中，证据识别一致……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: WARD 是一个纵向临床智能体评测基准，通过 4,560 个临床任务和纵向、交互两条赛道，系统诊断了模型在“证据识别→患者状态判断→及时安全行动”链条中的能力差距。
en_tdlr: WARD is a benchmark that diagnoses the evidence-to-state-to-action gap in longitudinal clinical agents, using 4,560 clinical tasks across longitudinal and interactive tracks to reveal where models fail to translate accumulating evidence into timely, safe clinical actions.
